程序包 org.bukkit.block.data.type

接口 Bed

所有超级接口:
BlockData, java.lang.Cloneable, Directional
public interface Bed extends Directional
与 Bisected 相似, 'part' 值表示该方块对应的是床的哪一部分.
'occupied' 值是一个用于检查当前是否有玩家睡在该床方块上的快速标识.

原文： Similar to Bisected, 'part' denotes which half of the bed this block corresponds to.
'occupied' property is a quick flag to check if a player is currently sleeping in this bed block.
